text:
oliver: Quick heads-up — we're bootstrapping eu-central4 GPU fleet tomorrow morning (A100s, 8 nodes) and need SRE handoff + a short on-call training session. Docs draft: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-central4-provisioning (please review).
sarah: thanks — what's the expected capacity and autoscale policy?
oliver: target capacity = 8 A100 nodes (p3d-equivalent), burst to 12 for first 72h. Autoscale: min=2, desired=8, max=12. Scaling metric = token-throughput-per-node and queue_latency.
jin: network note: cloud provider has ethernet MTU 8900 in eu-central4 but our default is 1500 — we'll enable jumbo frames on kube nodes. Need net team approval.
lia: paging config request? who gets paged for node GPU OOMs / high GPU temp / node down?
oliver: propose: primary = eng-sre (rotation), secondary = eng-infra oncall, tertiary = infra-owners (kevin). Severity mapping: sev1 = node down or complete capacity loss -> page immediately; sev2 = degraded throughput >30% for 15m -> alert to channel (no page), sev3 = cost spike warning -> slack notify.
kevin: +1. For pages: Opsgenie config snippet below. Lia can you add to our playbook?
kevin: ```json
{
  "condition": "node.role == 'gpu' && node.status == 'NotReady'",
  "notify": ["eng-sre-pager", "eng-infra-pager"],
  "escalation": ["eng-infra-pager:15m", "infra-owners:30m"]
}
```
oncall-bot: deploybot: runbook eu-central4-provisioning updated by oliver at 2026-02-15T07:12:03Z
sarah: validation checklist draft? can we get quick preflight to verify networking, quota, and image deployment?
jin: preflight list I ran locally: 1) Compute quota available (GPU=20) 2) VPC routes & peering exist 3) MTU/jumbo frames check 4) NFS throughput tests 5) image pull from our registry 6) time sync across nodes
lia: add alert tests: - simulate node drain, - simulate disk full, - simulate pod eviction under load. We'll validate paging triggers.
oliver: handoff steps I'm adding to runbook: - bootstrap: terraform apply with eu-central4 vars - kubeadm join script (attached) - enable GPU driver + nvidia-operator - deploy inference runtime with canary 10% traffic - run smoke prompt set (provided) - run load test 30m to reach sustained 70% GPU utilization - confirm autoscale behavior
sarah: include cost guardrails: set reserved spot pool usage limit at 40% and set budget alert at $X/day (estimate: €1800/day at full capacity)
kevin: who will own post-deploy monitoring for the first 72h? suggest eng-infra rotations for 24/7 coverage, eng-sre as escalation.
lia: I'll schedule a 45-min training tomorrow 09:30 CET: 15m runbook walkthrough, 20m alerting drills, 10m Q&A. Invite: @eng-sre, @eng-infra, oncall reps.
jin: test commands to validate GPU driver: ```bash
kubectl -n kube-system get pods | grep nvidia
# run nvidia-smi on node: ssh node-01 'nvidia-smi -L'
```
oliver: small gotcha — cloud provider's default firewall blocks healthcheck source IP range 35.200.0.0/16; open that to kube-probes or healthchecks will fail. noted in runbook.
kevin: escalation path doc please include phone numbers for primary/secondary, and a clear runbook step: if page during business hours, oncall handles and loops infra-owners within 30m; if after hours and not ack'd in 15m escalate automatically.
lia: added. Also adding a short "what to look for" checklist in runbook: - GPU temps >85C sustained - GPU memory errors - kubelet eviction notices - network packet drops >1%
kevin: cost-saving tip: enable prefix caching on inference runtime and set batching to target latency 150ms to reduce token cost ~18%. Documented in Optimize section.
sarah: any compliance/VPC restrictions? customer private endpoints need peering via hub-vpc. Confirmed by cloud-security.
jin: I'll run the preflight automation at 05:30 CET and post results here.
oliver: thanks all. Final action items: 1) lia schedule training (done) 2) jin run preflight and paste results (IN PROGRESS) 3) kevin update Opsgenie + phone roster 4) sarah add budget alert 5) oliver merge runbook and lock infra variables for bootstrap.
kevin: FYI I've created the opsgenie policy: https://opsgenie.redwood/alerts/CFG-3245 and added eng-sre rotation.
lia: training invite sent to channel. Agenda in doc.
jin: preflight results pasted: QUOTA_OK=true, VPC_OK=true, MTU_SET=true, IMAGE_PULL_OK=true, NFS_1Gbps=true, time_sync_ok=true. I simulated node NotReady and Opsgenie page fired correctly.
oliver: excellent. We'll start terraform apply at 08:00 CET. Please be oncall during 08:00-12:00 for quick rollback.
sarah: I'll be available 08:00-10:00 and can help with traffic routing.
kevin: rolling watch roster posted to runbook.
lia: postmortem plan: if we hit sev1 we run standard incident runbook, and reconvene for blameless postmortem within 72h.
oliver: closing loop — if anyone sees omissions ping me. Thanks for quick turnaround :thumbsup:
